conduct_outside_employment_001.evidence: Employees who wish to accept outside employment or engage in other activities for profit must submit a written request to their supervisor. Employees are required to disclose in writing to their immediate supervisor any outside employment that may create a potential conflict of interest with their assigned duties and responsibilities or the best interest of the district. Supervisors will consider outside employment on a case-by-case basis and determine whether it should be prohibited because of a conflict of interest.
